d: We are looking for an analytical, detail-oriented, and research-driven Market Research Analyst to join our growing team.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for conducting market research, analyzing industry trends, understanding customer behavior, evaluating competitors, and providing actionable insights to support strategic business decisions and growth opportunities.
Conduct primary and secondary market research to identify industry trends and business opportunities.
Collect, analyze, and interpret market, customer, and competitor data.
Research customer preferences, buying behavior, and market demands.
Monitor industry developments, emerging trends, and competitor activities.
Identify potential target markets, customer segments, and growth opportunities.
Design and conduct surveys, questionnaires, interviews, and research studies.
Analyze research findings and translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Prepare detailed market research reports, presentations, and dashboards.
Evaluate market size, industry performance, and competitive positioning.
Support business development, marketing, and strategic planning initiatives.
Collaborate with internal teams to understand research requirements and business objectives.
Maintain accurate research databases and ensure data reliability.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, or a relevant field.
1–2 years of experience in market research, business analysis, or data analysis (preferred).
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Familiarity with research tools, survey platforms, and data visualization software.
Understanding of market research methodologies and data collection techniques.
Excellent report writing and presentation skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to interpret complex information.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple research projects.
Knowledge of industry analysis and competitor benchmarking will be an added advantage.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute to strategic business decisions through research and analysis.
